name: Buffalo Chicken Casserole
desc: Roasted cauliflower and shredded chicken baked under a creamy buffalo ranch layer and melted Cheddar and Gouda.

source.title: Buffalo Cauliflower Chicken Casserole
source.evidence: Read via Punchfork's copy of the Delish recipe: every quantity the site had matches (12 oz cream cheese, 1/3 cup buffalo sauce, 1/4 cup ranch, 1/2 cup each cheddar and gouda, 2 cups chicken); supplies the oil, green onion and garlic powder amounts.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup ranch dressing, plus more for drizzling
1/3 cup sliced green onions, plus more for garnish

steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F. In a 9x13 in baking dish, toss the cauliflower with the olive oil and season with the salt and pepper.
Roast until tender, about 20 minutes. Reduce the oven to 350°F.
Meanwhile, stir together the cream cheese, buffalo sauce, ranch, green onions, and garlic powder in a medium bowl until combined.
Toss the chicken with the roasted cauliflower in the baking dish and spread the cream cheese mixture over the top.
Top with the Cheddar and Gouda and bake until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly, about 20 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes, then drizzle with ranch and garnish with more green onions.

references.title: Buffalo Cauliflower Chicken Casserole
